channel.title: Onchain Brief
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, security incidents, regulation and new blockchain networks.

item.title: Aztec brings back zk.money for private Ethereum payments
item.description: Aztec Labs has relaunched zk.money on its Aztec Network, giving users private crypto payments while leaving deposit transactions on Ethereum publicly visible.

item.title: How to bridge collateral for market shares on Polygon
item.description: To use collateral for market shares on Polygon, bridge a token the market accepts, check its network and token version, then leave enough POL for fees.

item.title: Why top holder percentages change after a supply update
item.description: A supply update can change every holder’s share without moving tokens. Check the denominator, wallet labels and timing before reading a shift in concentration.

item.title: How to check an unclaimed Polygon withdrawal
item.description: A Polygon withdrawal can be pending, ready to claim or complete; use the original wallet and transaction record to find its status and next step safely.

item.title: How Solana vault calls fit into aggregator swaps
item.description: A Solana vault call can put a cross-chain transfer inside a larger swap transaction, letting an aggregator combine a local trade with a Chainflip route.

item.title: What a Token Approval Does Before an Avalanche Swap
item.description: A token approval lets an Avalanche swap app spend a set amount of one asset; check the spender and allowance before signing, then review the swap separately.

item.title: Schedule Treasury Transfers Around Network Maintenance
item.description: Treasury teams can avoid stuck transfers by checking each network’s maintenance window, sending early, and keeping enough funds on the destination chain for payments.

item.title: How to Set Slippage for a Blackhole Swap
item.description: Set slippage just wide enough for a swap to clear: understand the minimum-output limit, adjust it when conditions change, and avoid masking a bad quote.

item.title: Why Chainflip signing retries can delay a swap
item.description: Chainflip swaps can pause after trading while validators retry a failed threshold-signing ceremony; the delay protects funds, but the protocol does not promise a fixed wait.

item.title: How to make repeated XMR swaps take less time
item.description: Repeated XMR-to-token swaps get faster when you prepare the route, wallet, and destination details in advance, while allowing for network confirmation time.

item.title: What a Protocol Upgrade Means for a Pending Swap
item.description: An upgrade can pause new quotes while a cross-chain swap is already moving. Its outcome depends on whether funds await deposit, execution or payout.

item.title: Polygon PoS withdrawals: the standard exit and faster routes
item.description: Polygon PoS withdrawals burn tokens on the sidechain, then wait for an Ethereum checkpoint and proof; faster liquidity routes trade that wait for added cost.

item.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody rules for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed rules letting advisers and funds self-custody some crypto or use state trust companies, with safeguards and a 60-day comment period.

item.title: Wide or Narrow? How to Choose an LP Price Range
item.description: A wide LP range stays active across more prices, while a narrow range can use capital more tightly but needs closer monitoring and may go idle sooner.

item.title: SEC proposes new custody paths for crypto advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed new custody options for advisers and funds holding some crypto assets, including limited self-custody and state trust companies.

item.title: How LP fronting gets tokens to another chain sooner
item.description: LP fronting lets a provider send tokens on the destination chain first, then recover funds after the source transfer settles; speed depends on liquidity, fees and settlement.

item.title: Poocoin: How to Compare Token Prices Across Trading Pairs
item.description: Poocoin can help compare BNB Smart Chain token prices, but a pair’s quote, liquidity and trade size all affect whether the displayed price is useful.

item.title: BaseSwap: Should You Swap Tokens or Add Liquidity?
item.description: A swap changes one token into another; a liquidity pool supplies tokens for other traders. Your goal, time frame and tolerance for price changes point to the better fit.

item.title: FCA opens crypto authorisation applications ahead of 2027 rules
item.description: The FCA has opened its crypto authorisation window, giving UK firms until 28 February 2027 to apply before wider rules take effect in October.
